objects.title: Components of HDP
objects.description: Key components within the Helios Data Platform include ingest workers, query API, and Redis cache.
objects.body: HDP's architecture comprises several critical components: Ingest workers that are responsible for pulling in source records and normalizing them for further processing; a Query API that serves as the interface for analytics dashboards; and a Redis cache positioned strategically to enhance the performance of data queries by acting as an intermediary layer ahead of the query API.
